name: Zod
summary: Documentation for Zod 4, the TypeScript-first schema validation library with static type inference and zero dependencies.
description: The docs site for Zod: define schemas for everything from a simple string to a complex nested object, parse data and get static TypeScript types. It covers the full schema API, refinements, transforms, codecs and pipes, error customisation and formatting, JSON Schema conversion, ahead-of-time compilation with z.compile() for hot paths, the ecosystem of form and API integrations, and guidance for library authors. Zod 4 also ships Zod Mini and Zod Core packages, a 2 kB gzipped core, an MCP server and llms.txt for agents.
contains: schema API: primitives, strings, numbers, objects, arrays, unions, records, maps, sets, files, promises
refinements, transforms, codecs and pipes; z.input() and z.output()
error customisation, i18n and formatters: treeifyError, prettifyError, formatError, flattenError
JSON Schema conversion: z.toJSONSchema() and z.fromJSONSchema()
ahead-of-time compilation with z.compile() for hot validation paths
packages: Zod, Zod Mini, Zod Core; 2 kB gzipped core, zero external dependencies
MCP server and llms.txt for agents; tested against TypeScript 5.5+
